create.name: Jerri Doran
create.bio:
Jerri Doran is a shamanic practitioner and teacher based in Salida, in the mountains of central Colorado, where she works under the name Shamanwings Healing. Her spiritual search began in 1990 and led her through several healing paths before she started training in the Medicine Wheel in 2007. She works in the Andean Q'ero tradition of Peru, in which she has received initiation as a priestess and wisdomkeeper, and names Ginger Lee and Clarke St. Dennis as her main teachers, in a lineage that includes Don Antonio and Alberto Villoldo. Travel to sacred sites such as Machu Picchu, Ausangate and Chaco Canyon is part of her practice.

She teaches in person near Salida: one-day introductions to shamanism and to shamanic journeying, each closing with a fire ceremony, and a two-year Medicine Wheel programme of weekend workshops in which students receive initiations, build a medicine bundle and learn ceremonial work. She also offers private shamanic sessions, in person or by phone, as well as land and house clearings and ceremonies for weddings and for the dying. Her recorded journeys to the lower and upper worlds, with rattle and drum tracks, are free on YouTube and Insight Timer, and she appears at holistic fairs around Colorado.

courses.title: Medicine Wheel Series
courses.description: A training in the Q'ero tradition held over ten weekends across about two years near Salida. Students move through the four directions of the wheel, receive a series of initiations, build a personal medicine bundle and learn journeying and ceremony, with advanced weekends later on.
courses.price: $500 per weekend (meals and lodging not included)

courses.title: One-Day Shamanic Journeying
courses.description: A one-day workshop near Salida devoted to shamanic journeying. Participants make at least four journeys, to the lower, middle and upper worlds, practise breathwork and close with a fire ceremony.

courses.title: Shamanic Healing Sessions
courses.description: Private shamanic energy sessions in person near Salida or by telephone, usually lasting an hour to an hour and a half. Depending on need, she works with clearing heavy energies, illumination of old patterns and soul retrieval.

free_resources.title: Jerri Doran on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free recorded shamanic journeys to the lower and upper worlds, angel and guide meditations and a short overview of what journeying involves. Anyone can listen in the app or a browser.
